name: v7
description: The canonical v7 roof-recon pipeline. Drives the full v7 chain (tile-signals → beam-incidence → hemisphere-segment → seed → density-voids → grow-refit-merge → boundary-topology → -signals → -corners → -polygons-2 → -regularize → -classify → wall-detect) from a bench-v2 real test case (.json + .bin sidecar), then emits two intrinsic-quality scores: v7-score-intrinsic on grm-* (the pre-wall-detect ROOF reconstruction quality) and v7-score-intrinsic-postwall on the post-wall-detect TLV + wd-owner (the FULL post-wall model quality). The delta tells you what wall-detect changed. Renamed from research-v7-tile-signals-real — the old name traced the historical extraction order. As of task #71 bp1 (v7-boundary-polygons) is retired; bp2 (v7-boundary-polygons-2) is the canonical polygon step and the v7-bp2 sibling pipeline was retired in the same task. See v3/docs/plan/PHASE-5-V7-PORT.md.
